description_en: Queries the list of created monitoring sessions
description_zh: 查询已创建的监播室列表
name: DescribeLiveStreamMonitorList

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the monitoring session.

Obtain the MonitorId value from the response parameters of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848129.html operation. If you leave this parameter empty, the data of all monitoring sessions is returned
parameters.help_zh:
监播室ID。
通过查看https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848129.html接口的返回参数获取MonitorId值。若参数为空，默认返回所有监播室合并后的数据
parameters.name: monitor_id

parameters.help_en: The number of monitoring sessions to return on each page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The status of the monitoring session. Valid values:

1: The session is being monitored.

0: The session is not being monitored
parameters.help_zh:
监播室内状态。取值：

1：监播中。
0：未监播
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The order in which to sort the monitoring sessions. Valid values:

0: Default. The monitoring sessions are sorted by monitoring status in descending order (active sessions are listed first). The start time is not used for sorting.

1: The monitoring sessions are sorted by start time in descending order.

2: The monitoring sessions are sorted by start time in ascending order
parameters.help_zh:
启动时间顺序。取值：

0：默认（按启动状态倒序，启动时间不参与排序）。
1：启动时间倒序。
2：启动时间正序
parameters.name: order_rule

AudioFrom.description_en: The audio source in the layout

CallbackUrl.description_zh: 监播告警通知回调地址

DingTalkWebHookUrl.description_en: The URL of the DingTalk chatbot

Domain.description_en: The output domain name for monitoring

InputList.description_en: The list of input streams for monitoring

Index.description_en: The index. This parameter is used by the frontend

InputUrl.description_en: The URL of the input stream

FillMode.description_en: The fill mode. For frontend development, set this parameter to none

PositionNormalized.description_en: The normalized coordinates of the element's position, in the format of [x,y]. The default value is [0,0]. The values of x and y must be normalized
PositionNormalized.description_zh: 位置归一化值[unk][x,y][unk]，默认为[unk][0,0][unk]。>x，y需要进行归一化计算

items.description_en:
The position of the element's fill area, in the format of [x,y]. The values of x and y are normalized percentages.
For example, [0.1,0.1] indicates a horizontal offset of 10% and a vertical offset of 10% from the top-left corner
items.description_zh:
表示该Layer元素填充区位置[x,y]，x和y归一化百分比。
例如[0.1,0.1]代表左上角水平偏移10%, 垂直偏移10%

PositionRefer.description_en:
The reference point for the element's position. Valid values:

topLeft

topRight

bottomLeft

bottomRight
PositionRefer.description_zh:
设置元素的position参考坐标值，取值：

topLeft
topRight
bottomLeft
bottomRight

SizeNormalized.description_en: The normalized size of the element's fill area, in the format of [w,h]
SizeNormalized.description_zh: 字幕文件大小，单位为字节

items.description_en:
The size of the element's fill area, in the format of [w,h]. The values of w and h are normalized percentages.
For example, [0.2,0.3] indicates a horizontal proportion of 20% and a vertical proportion of 30%
items.description_zh:
Layer元素需要填充的尺寸大小[w,h]，w和h归一化百分比。
例如[0.2,0.3]代表水平占比20%，垂直占比30%

LayoutId.description_en: The layout ID. The value must start from 1

VolumeRate.description_en: The volume. The value must be between 0 and 1, inclusive, with up to two decimal places
VolumeRate.description_zh: 音量。取值0~1之间，精确小数点后2位

StreamName.description_en: The display name of the stream for monitoring

MonitorConfig.description_en:
The settings for monitoring alert thresholds. The value is a JSON string that includes the following fields:

fpsLowThres: the alert threshold for the video frame rate. This is a float.

brHighThres: the alert threshold for the audio and video bitrate. This is a float.

eofDurationThresSec: the alert threshold for the stream interruption duration. This is a float
MonitorConfig.description_zh:
监播告警阈值设置。参数字段如下：
fpsLowThres：视频帧率告警阈值，Float类型。
brHighThres：音视频码率告警阈值，Float类型。
eofDurationThresSec：断流时长检测阈值，Float类型
